description: Defines the interface IScreenCapture for screen capture functionalities, including methods for uploading and sending screenshots, and notification callbacks for upload completion.

classes.name: IScreenCapture
classes.description: Interface for screen capture operations, including upload and send methods, and notification registration.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Structure indicating success status of screen capture operations.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for screen capture events.

methods.name: UploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Takes a screenshot and uploads it to a specified URL.

methods.name: SendScreenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot and uploads it, using a call GUID to identify the request.
